exposure: mode of termination of the last delivery
fear experienced at the last delivery
anxiety experienced at the last delivery
cohort: The study included 305 married pregnant women with a mean age of 28.04 years, who were in the last trimester of their pregnancy.
finding: Factors such as income status, number of miscarriages/mortal deliveries, mode of last delivery, and fear/anxiety experienced at the last delivery were statistically significantly associated with the perception of traumatic childbirth.
mod_finding: The mode of termination of the last delivery was found to be statistically significantly associated with the perception of traumatic childbirth.
cross-section timing: during the last trimester of pregnancy
